apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

job-result.eventDescription: One job posting written to the default dataset.

company-result.eventDescription: One enriched company record written to the default dataset; priced at three times the job-result event for the same subscription tier.

reasonForChange: Proposal only: when activating tiered pricing in Apify Console, add job-result and company-result and remove apify-default-dataset-item in the same pricing change to prevent double charging. Keep apify-actor-start at $0.00005.
